notes:
- Fixed the standalone header: on narrower effects (notably DT Width) and effects with long titles (e.g. "Multiband Exciter"), the plugin title no longer runs underneath the BYPASS / UNDO / REDO / CHECK and PRESETS / SAVE control bar — the title is now always fully visible with its own clear space.
- The fix is robust for any title length: each editor sizes itself so the title never collides with the control bar, and the title also hard-clips to its own region as a safety net.
- Everything from 1.0.2 remains: 2-decimal dial readouts (correct "2.00:1" ratio), the visible BYPASS / UNDO / REDO / CHECK control bar, master Bypass, Undo/Redo history, on-demand Check for Updates, and the safer atomic self-update.
